scientific_question: With c_proj layers 8-11 always procedural, can at most four dense LWT exceptions inside difficult layers 0-7 close the exact same-gauge bounded-chart endpoint while every remaining c_proj layer uses the procedural approximation?

theory.paper_mechanism: LWT is the paper's explicit response to layer-specific manifolds. The accepted same-gauge late-band run independently confirms that procedural c_proj compatibility is depth heterogeneous.
theory.same_gauge_correction: Prior donor c_proj and whole-MLP layer allocation was invalidated by cross-run co-adaptation. Here every dense and approximated tensor comes from one accepted full-state parent phase; no tensor or module is imported from another run.
theory.allocation_not_new_chart: The bounded hidden64+24/output32 chart and eight-substep phase replay are frozen. Layers 8-11 are always reconstructed procedurally, matching the accepted late-band allocation; only the architectural decision of which early/middle layers must remain dense is measured.
theory.selection_control: Rank single-layer dense repairs on the first 64 registered validation batches, choose the smallest top-k prefix with k<=4 and discovery gap <=0.005, then freeze it before viewing a disjoint 128-batch holdout and the full 400-batch multi-phase confirmation.
theory.oracle_limit: Phase chords and matching connectivity are target-selected capacity oracles. A pass authorizes only a mask theory and a separately preregistered same-gauge training test after correctness and MFU gates.

selection.selected_prefix: smallest discovery prefix within 0.005 CE of dense
selection.failure_fallback: top-four prefix for diagnostic confirmation only

decision_rule.pass: A replicated minimal mask authorizes only a same-gauge LWT mask theory. Implementation, MFU, and training require a new plan.
decision_rule.overselected: If the predecessor also passes exact confirmation, do not shrink the mask post hoc; register a new independent validation plan.
decision_rule.fail: Reject expansion beyond the accepted late 8-11 procedural band at the four-dense-layer budget. Do not sweep masks, thresholds, cadence, or chart structure.

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable because this analysis performs zero model or optimizer updates
